steps.text: Demo loop (npm run dev): approve the gate, click "agent's next session ▸" — the board updates itself, no reload
ask ▸ — "what is waiting on me?" answers from the live board; "what does the diamond mean?" opens the manual at the section
Wizard (npm run dev:new): pick a real folder in "where" — after submit the files are in that folder and the board is live
This view: commit hashes open GitHub; decide this gate here — it lands signed in plan/decisions-inbox/ and I act next session
